verdict.rationale: GitCafe is a Git forge, so built-in AI insights (for example, PR summaries or review suggestions) are a fair axis. However, the evidence only shows ways for external AI tools to reach GitCafe data: an MCP server, WebMCP tools offered to the browser's own agent, agent skills for coding assistants, and Markdown/llms.txt views. Nothing documents AI-generated insights or suggestions produced inside the product itself.
